## Conditioned Merge

![Conditioned Merge icon](../../assets/icons/ConditionedMergeComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Z1c` · GUID `4bf2f852-144c-4afb-8dcc-8c016787f571` · exposure primary

Merges the conditioned zones of the floor and, separately, the unconditioned ones (Z1c); a zone is conditioned when its program preset has a thermostat. Zones that share a wall merge; Join Pieces decides whether separate pieces of one class stay apart. Conditioned floor area is kept exactly. Every outdoor wall gets one centred window with the glazed area of the windows it covers.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plan | `Plan` | [Plan](info.md#plan) | item | no | – | Detailed plan. |
| Join Pieces | `J` | Boolean | item | no | `False` | False: one zone per connected piece of each class. True: one conditioned and one unconditioned zone on the floor, each made of all its pieces. |
| Preview Location | `PL` | Vector | item | yes | `{0,0,0}` | Moves this component's viewport preview by this vector, in model units; the data and all outputs keep their true coordinates. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floor | `Floor` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | item | The simplified floor. |

## Perimeter Core

![Perimeter Core icon](../../assets/icons/PerimeterCoreComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Z2` · GUID `6a86b976-c838-427f-93a7-344dcc2c18ce` · exposure primary

Perimeter zones per orientation plus a core (Z2); corners split on the bisectors. Every outdoor wall gets one centred window with the glazed area of the windows it covers.

## Semantic Merge

![Semantic Merge icon](../../assets/icons/SemanticMergeComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Z1` · GUID `7d36f1d3-2708-4b69-b1a7-cf294c186e9a` · exposure primary

Merges zones of the same space type that share a wall (Z1); Join Pieces decides whether separate pieces of one type stay apart. Every outdoor wall gets one centred window with the glazed area of the windows it covers.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |

| Plan | `Plan` | [Plan](info.md#plan) | item | no | – | Detailed plan. |
| Join Pieces | `J` | Boolean | item | no | `False` | False: one zone per connected piece of each space type. True: one zone per space type on the floor, made of all its pieces. |
| Preview Location | `PL` | Vector | item | yes | `{0,0,0}` | Moves this component's viewport preview by this vector, in model units; the data and all outputs keep their true coordinates. |

**Outputs**

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floor | `Floor` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | item | The simplified floor. |

**Example definitions:** `court-cluster.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/court-cluster.png)), `foyer-halls.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/foyer-halls.png)), `program-json-office.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/program-json-office.png)), `radial-lobes.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/radial-lobes.png)), `stair-bay-bar.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/stair-bay-bar.png)), `terrace-row.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/terrace-row.png)).
